last_transition_reason: Lemma L3 is false as stated, so A2 cannot be justified and the proof skeleton does not establish the theorem.
role_in_parent: Core cellwise estimate in offset coordinates.
statement_nl: For every positive integer n, every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, and every real d with 0 <= d < 1/n, one has K_{n,j}(d) <= K_{n,j}(0).

domain_restrictions: n is a positive integer (so n is at least 1)
j is an integer satisfying 0 <= j <= n - 1 (so j is an integer between 0 and n - 1 inclusive)
d is a real number satisfying 0 <= d < 1/n (so d includes 0 but excludes 1/n)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n, for every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, and for every real d with 0 <= d < 1/n, K_{n,j}(d) is less than or equal to K_{n,j}(0).
quantifier_order: for all integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1
for all real d with 0 <= d < 1/n

variables.name: j
variables.role: index parameter for K, dependent on n

variables.name: d
variables.role: input variable to K, dependent on n
